source.test: createNewServer(..., javaPath: String? = nil) install-step java invocation

notes: createNewServer's `javaPath` parameter (line 144, default nil) is threaded into every NeoForge/Forge installer invocation (e.g. line 204, 210, 225, 231) as `javaPath ?? configManager.config.javaPath`. There is no field on `ConfigServer` for a per-server java path -- this override is scoped to the one create call (e.g. a remote-API create request that specified `javaPath`, per `RemoteAPIServerDTOs.swift:147`), not persisted for later starts of that server. When present, it wins over the app-wide default.
